d:
Celebrate the beautiful spirit of Karwa Chauth with Apni Mang Suhagan Ho from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham in this special Lyrical Video.
Featuring the unforgettable voices of Amit Kumar, Sonu Nigam, Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan & Kavita Krishnamurthy, with music by Jatin-Lalit and lyrics by Sameer Anjaan, this timeless melody beautifully captures the love, devotion and togetherness of Karwa Chauth.
Relive the iconic moments of Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol and let this evergreen Bollywood melody make your Karwa Chauth celebrations even more special.
Credits:
Song Name: Apni Mang Suhagan Ho
